programDefinitions.name: Foundation Barbell 5×5
programDefinitions.description: Three sessions a week, two alternating workouts, one rule: finish every set of five and the bar gets heavier next time. The simplest way to build a base of strength.
prerequisites: Can perform the five basic barbell lifts with an empty bar

programDefinitions.name: Double Progression Builder
programDefinitions.description: Every exercise owns a rep range. Fill the range on every set and the load goes up; until then the load waits while your reps climb. Four days, upper/lower.
prerequisites: Around six months of consistent training

programDefinitions.name: Tiered Stage Ladder
programDefinitions.description: Three tiers of work. When a heavy tier stalls, you do not deload — you trade reps for sets and keep the bar moving through three stages before resetting lighter.
prerequisites: Finished a linear progression program
Knows an approximate 5-rep max on the main lifts

programDefinitions.name: Heavy-Light-Medium 5×5
programDefinitions.description: One heavy day, one light day, one medium day that ends with a single top triple. Beat Friday's triple and the whole next week moves up 2.5 percent.
prerequisites: Session-to-session progression has stalled
Knows current 5-rep maxes
programDefinitions.notes: Success on the Medium day top triple is what 'weekCompleted' verifies for each *-top exposure; failing it marks the exposure failed for the week.

programDefinitions.name: Percent Cycle 4-Week
programDefinitions.description: Four-week waves of fives, threes, and heavy singles against a conservative training max. The last main set of each day is open-ended — rep records drive the next cycle.
prerequisites: About a year of training
A known or estimable one-rep max on the four main lifts

mainDayTemplate.comment: Each block week w and lift L expands to: main percents below of trainingMax(L), then first-set-last 5×5 at the week's first percent, then assistance.

programDefinitions.expansionNote: Weeks 1-3 are authored as transformations of week 0; the seed importer materializes all four weeks explicitly per block before validation, and the block repeats three times (12 weeks total).

programDefinitions.name: Wave Builder
programDefinitions.description: Two six-week phases built from three-week waves. Volume climbs in the base phase, intensity in the peak. The rep-record set at the end of each wave sets the next wave's weights.
prerequisites: Comfortable with percentage training and true rep-record sets
programDefinitions.expansionNote: The importer materializes each day from dayLayout, attaching the wave template to the main/developmental exercise ($self = the exercise's own exposure, $main = its mainRef). Waves advance via state, so the six template weeks per phase are identical; the wave index selects the week shape.

programDefinitions.name: RPE Bridge Block
programDefinitions.description: Learn to drive training by how heavy the bar actually feels. Work to one honest top set at a target effort, take percentage back-offs from it, and let the app suggest starting weights from your ratings.
prerequisites: About a year of training
Willing to rate every hard set on the RPE scale

sessionTemplates.topAndBackoff: top set: 1×N @ target RPE with load manual, min/max = 0.8–0.9 × e1RM($self); then 3 deferred back-off sets ×5 at 92.5% of the completed top set (generatesAfterSourceCompletion).

programDefinitions.name: Undulating Upper/Lower
programDefinitions.description: Each big lift appears twice a week wearing different hats: one heavy strength exposure, one higher-rep volume exposure. Each exposure keeps its own weights and progresses on its own rules.
prerequisites: A year or more of training

programDefinitions.name: Six-Week Block Strength
programDefinitions.description: Six weeks from volume to a platform-ready max: two weeks of muscular conditioning, a strength week, a heavy acclimation week, a peak week of near-max singles, then a taper and test day.
prerequisites: Confident technique on squat, bench, and deadlift
Known one-rep maxes

programDefinitions.name: Bench Press Specialization Matrix
warnings: Advanced program: bench press four times per week at high volume.
Requires an established pressing base, good recovery, and an honest current max.
All other heavy pressing is removed for the duration.
Do not run back-to-back; take at least a full training block between attempts.
programDefinitions.description: Three weeks, twelve sessions, one lift. Every workout is precomputed from your entered max, and each week adds a small fixed amount on top of the percentages. Finish, rest, and test.
prerequisites: Two or more years of training
Pain-free pressing
A current, honest bench press max

intakeInputs.hint: Use a real, recent max — not a goal

programDefinitions.name: Bodyweight Ladder Foundations
programDefinitions.description: Progress by earning harder exercises, not by adding plates. Each movement slot climbs a ladder of variations: own the rep range with clean form and the app offers you the next rung.

programDefinitions.name: Accumulation Wave Upper/Lower
programDefinitions.description: Hold the weight, add a set each week. When you complete the full five-set week, the wave converts into a heavier bar and the set count resets. Three waves, then an easy week.
prerequisites: Six or more months of training

programDefinitions.name: Velocity-Calibrated Strength
warnings: Experimental: designed around bar-speed readings from any velocity device or app, entered manually.
Works without a device — velocity rules simply stay silent and the percentage plan carries you.
programDefinitions.description: Let bar speed set the day's weights. A standard warm-up single tells the app how you're moving today; main work stays inside a target speed zone and stops before grinding.
prerequisites: Consistent technique on the main lifts
A velocity device or app is recommended

structure: Warm-up ramp singles at 45% / 60% / 75% of 1RM; the 75% single is the readiness probe (velocity logged, progressionEligible false except probe evaluation).
Main: 4×3 at 80% of 1RM, targetMeanVelocity zone 0.50–0.70 m/s, velocityLossStopPercent 20.
